semantics.hard_gates: a provider that fails any gate is NOT eligible; a gate whose capture value is null or missing is UNKNOWN, which also blocks eligibility and is printed as ⚠️.
semantics.null_policy: declared per criterion: 'neutral' = a null value scores 1.0 for that provider even when other providers have numbers (the ⚠️-deferred latency items); 'fail' = a null scores 0.0 when at least one provider has a number, and is neutral for every provider when all of them are null.
semantics.noise_tolerance: providers whose totals are within params.noise_tolerance of the best total form one tie band; inside a band the ranking is decided by the declared tie-break in README §4, never by prose.
